1 module GameData
    2   #=============================================================================
    3   # A mixin module for data classes which provides common class methods (called
    4   # by GameData::Thing.method) that provide access to data held within.
    5   # Assumes the data class's data is stored in a class constant hash called DATA.
    6   # For data that is known by a symbol or an ID number.
    7   #=============================================================================
    8   module ClassMethods
    9     def schema
   10       return self::SCHEMA
   11     end
   12 
   13     def register(hash)
   14       self::DATA[hash[:id]] = self::DATA[hash[:id_number]] = self.new(hash)
   15     end
   16 
   17     # @param other [Symbol, self, String, Integer]
   18     # @return [Boolean] whether the given other is defined as a self
   19     def exists?(other)
   20       return false if other.nil?
   21       validate other => [Symbol, self, String, Integer]
   22       other = other.id if other.is_a?(self)
   23       other = other.to_sym if other.is_a?(String)
   24       return !self::DATA[other].nil?
   25     end
   26 
   27     # @param other [Symbol, self, String, Integer]
   28     # @return [self]
   29     def get(other)
   30       validate other => [Symbol, self, String, Integer]
   31       return other if other.is_a?(self)
   32       other = other.to_sym if other.is_a?(String)
   33       raise "Unknown ID #{other}." unless self::DATA.has_key?(other)
   34       return self::DATA[other]
   35     end
   36 
   37     # @param other [Symbol, self, String, Integer]
   38     # @return [self, nil]
   39     def try_get(other)
   40       return nil if other.nil?
   41       validate other => [Symbol, self, String, Integer]
   42       return other if other.is_a?(self)
   43       other = other.to_sym if other.is_a?(String)
   44       return (self::DATA.has_key?(other)) ? self::DATA[other] : nil
   45     end
   46 
   47     # Returns the array of keys for the data.
   48     # @return [Array]
   49     def keys
   50       return self::DATA.keys
   51     end
   52 
   53     # Yields all data in order of their id_number.
   54     def each
   55       sorted_keys = self::DATA.keys.sort { |a, b| self::DATA[a].id_number <=> self::DATA[b].id_number }
   56       sorted_keys.each { |key| yield self::DATA[key] if !key.is_a?(Integer) }
   57     end
   58 
   59     def count
   60       return self::DATA.length / 2
   61     end
   62 
   63     def load
   64       const_set(:DATA, load_data("Data/#{self::DATA_FILENAME}"))
   65     end
   66 
   67     def save
   68       save_data(self::DATA, "Data/#{self::DATA_FILENAME}")
   69     end
   70   end

  212   #=============================================================================
  213   # A mixin module for data classes which provides common instance methods
  214   # (called by thing.method) that analyse the data of a particular thing which
  215   # the instance represents.
  216   #=============================================================================
  217   module InstanceMethods
  218     # @param other [Symbol, self.class, String, Integer]
  219     # @return [Boolean] whether other represents the same thing as this thing
  220     def ==(other)
  221       return false if other.nil?
  222       case other
  223       when Symbol
  224         return @id == other
  225       when self.class
  226         return @id == other.id
  227       when String
  228         return @id == other.to_sym
  229       when Integer
  230         return @id_number == other
  231       end
  232       return false
  233     end
  234 
  235     def get_property_for_PBS(key)
  236       ret = nil
  237       if self.class::SCHEMA.include?(key) && self.respond_to?(self.class::SCHEMA[key][0])
  238         ret = self.send(self.class::SCHEMA[key][0])
  239         ret = nil if ret == false || (ret.is_a?(Array) && ret.length == 0)
  240       end
  241       return ret
  242     end
  243   end

  245   #=============================================================================
  246   # A bulk loader method for all data stored in .dat files in the Data folder.
  247   #=============================================================================
  248   def self.load_all
  249     self.constants.each do |c|
  250       next if !self.const_get(c).is_a?(Class)
  251       self.const_get(c).load if self.const_get(c).const_defined?(:DATA_FILENAME)
  252     end
  253   end
  254 
  255   def self.get_all_data_filenames
  256     ret = []
  257     self.constants.each do |c|
  258       next if !self.const_get(c).is_a?(Class)
  259       next if !self.const_get(c).const_defined?(:DATA_FILENAME)
  260       if self.const_get(c).const_defined?(:OPTIONAL) && self.const_get(c)::OPTIONAL
  261         ret.push([self.const_get(c)::DATA_FILENAME, false])
  262       else
  263         ret.push([self.const_get(c)::DATA_FILENAME, true])
  264       end
  265     end
  266     return ret
  267   end
  268 
  269   def self.get_all_pbs_base_filenames
  270     ret = {}
  271     self.constants.each do |c|
  272       next if !self.const_get(c).is_a?(Class)
  273       ret[c] = self.const_get(c)::PBS_BASE_FILENAME if self.const_get(c).const_defined?(:PBS_BASE_FILENAME)
  274       next if !ret[c].is_a?(Array)
  275       ret[c].length.times do |i|
  276         next if i == 0
  277         ret[(c.to_s + i.to_s).to_sym] = ret[c][i]   # :Species1 => "pokemon_forms"
  278       end
  279       ret[c] = ret[c][0]   # :Species => "pokemon"
  280     end
  281     return ret
  282   end
